description: An executable in a per-user or common Start Menu Startup folder matches, in both path forms; a Start Menu folder whose name only begins with Startup, and a program merely named startup, do not.

cases.name: an executable in the per-user Startup folder -> match
device form: an executable in the common StartUp folder -> match
near miss: a Start Menu folder named Startup Tools -> no match
near miss: a program named startup.exe under Program Files -> no match
